properties.notes: Potential opportunity for redevelopment of a site in Cambois. The land currently part occupied by an existing dwelling which would require demolition prior to new-build development. The site could potentially be part of wider scheme of redevelopment at Cambois, including other sites identified in the SHLAA (5047, 5048 and 5098). An outline permission was granted for 6 three-bed dwellings, following demolition, but this was not commenced and has lapsed due to non-implementation (12/03080/OUT). Before this, an application for 6 units was withdrawn before determination (12/00219/OUT).
properties.ownership-status: not owned by a public authority
